title: vernonanthura rigiophylla
intro: Vernonanthura rigiophylla, commonly known as the "Brazilian Rosemary", is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and improve cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Vernonanthura rigiophylla include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety and depression, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
